name: Having A Lot Of Children
overview: Scripture affirms that having many children is a blessing from the LORD, as seen in Genesis 1:28 where God commands to be fruitful and multiply, and in Psalms 127:3 which declares children are a heritage and reward from God. The imagery of children as olive plants surrounding the table (Psalms 128:3) and the crown of old men (Proverbs 17:6) highlights the honor and joy that offspring bring to a family. Furthermore, Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes the responsibility to train children in the way of the Lord, ensuring that this blessing leads to a godly legacy. These verses collectively underscore the divine purpose and blessing in having many children within a Christ-centered family.
